task: T08 CLEAR_REMEASURE — the first valid stage_clear measurement over the three longest-surviving checkpoints plus R0, on the new SHOOT-pulse instrument

instrument.release_rule: decision i with release_due(i, 48) carries mask & ~(BTN_SHOOT|BTN_BOMB) on its last STEP frame
instrument.why_it_can_report_clear: the v4.1.0 ruler ORs BTN_SHOOT into every mask and has no release path, so the engine never sees the SHOOT rising edge it needs to leave the end-of-stage wait state

protocol.seeds: dev 1000-1019 (20 seeds, four batches of five)
protocol.data_dirs: one private cp -a copy of .tmp_v420_data/T08/data/template-env per arm x ruler; the read-only blobs stay symlinks to /root/v400-data/game
protocol.checkpoints: copied from their read-only homes; source and copy sha256 match

verdict.capability_criterion: at least one stage_clear among the 4 arms x 2 rulers x 20 dev seeds = 160 episodes
verdict.ordering_criterion: any arm whose new-instrument diag or s1n mean exceeds R0's new-instrument mean
verdict.branch_text: (2) no stage_clear but some arm beats R0 on frames -> frames improved, capability not reached

branch_4_checked.reason: no episode cleared, so there is no arm whose clear count could disagree with its frames

instrument_validity.positive_control: tools/rl/v420_eval_shoot.py reports stage_clear on the recorded Stage-1 tape at period 48 (frames 13195, score 2631430) and game_over at period 1000000007; mask_trace_sha256 reproduced bit-for-bit (T08 EVAL_SHOOT_PULSE.md / CLEAR_REACHABILITY.md, read-only here)
instrument_validity.negative_control: same tape, pulse never fires -> game_over at 15564 frames

determinism.what: two independent runs of the same arm/ruler/seeds: (a) the T08 setup task's rows first observed before this task started, (b) my own top-up rerun in a private cp -a data dir
determinism.note: the evaluator is deterministic at fixed seed; wall time is not

old_instrument.caveat: the old ruler (tools/rl/v410_student_eval.py) holds SHOOT on every frame; the new ruler releases it once per 48 decisions. They therefore play different games. A new-minus-old difference is NOT drift evidence for the same policy on the same task; it is a different channel. The old numbers are quoted only to show what each arm's number used to be bound to.

not_claimed: single training seed per arm (seed 0); no seed-variance claim
n = 20 dev episodes per arm per ruler; no gate, no pass rate, no Wilson interval is claimed as a capability rate
this is a pixel-only evaluation (obs-v3 playfield + HUD + action history); the engine STATE reply is a referee for death/stage/score, never a policy input, and was not used as privileged information

it sits outside engine_truth: no engine reward or termination signal feeds the policy, so this is an R1-scoped (pixels-only) evaluation, but with NO training, NO fine-tuning and NO privileged information — pure evaluation of existing checkpoints
dev seeds only: no confirm seed (60000-60199), no corpus seed (1-20), no gate seed
the frames are not a clear rate; a stage_clear count of zero does not bound the clear rate above by anything except n
no causal claim about why a checkpoint survives longer or shorter; no arm was trained or tuned in response to these numbers

measurement.note: the deepest episode is still short of the 13,195-frame clear, so no episode can be a false negative from the old ruler's missing release
